tts_summary: Hey there! Winger is settling into his golden senior years at eight — you know how Goldens stay affectionate and food‑motivated but often slow down and tire more easily. At this stage his joints, dental comfort, and weight matter most; it's a good time for a senior wellness checkup with your vet to baseline mobility, bloodwork, and dental health. Expect short, joyful bursts of fetch, longer naps, heavier shedding, and more careful pacing on walks. Floppy ears and seasonal allergens can also affect him, so keep an eye on ear checks and indoor air on smoky days. The plan below focuses on senior food, joint and omega support, hydration and comfy gear. Take a look at the recommendations below.
